domain.text: Software engineering: OpenChamber worker-session lifecycle and worktree cleanup

impressions.text: The change adds session closing and reopening to the worker lifecycle, while preserving unrelated metadata and skipping live, unknown, and Claude sessions.
The worker reported passing formatting, lint, typecheck, tests, build, smoke, and other verification, with CI green.
The orchestrator reported a live smoke test that reopened and then closed a session whose worktree was already gone, without leaving a stray directory.
The worker noted that the specified live OpenChamber-list acceptance check remained for after merge; no live list observation was claimed in that review comment.
